subject: org.example.interaction@0.1.0, Python reference with authenticated loopback transport
assumptions: Reviewed Python interpreter and standard integer/Boolean semantics on validated natural inputs; actual branch and call-site scope is recorded for each derivation.

Serialized instance generation and per-stream condition; SQLite committed transactions, owner-local authority and durable storage survive a process stop. Cryptographic digests use the stated hash function.
Progress has finite selected input, a scheduled available owner and delivered credit before the deadline. The local deterministic agent has no tokenizer or inference charge.

The private alias replacement, denied charge, browser renderer fallback and soft deadlines are local reference behaviors. Target-specific production claims require separate authenticated observations.

interaction.dispatchRequirements.criterion: Exactly the inspected, admitted, bound, active, scoped current generation can dispatch.

interaction.revokedNoDispatch.criterion: Disabling an instance prevents fresh dispatch for all owners and epochs.

interaction.delegationNonAmplifying.criterion: A granted arbitrary-length path requires its parent grant and each admitted edge.

interaction.scopedDispatch.criterion: An admitted hop preserves tenant, recipient, resource, policy epoch, freshness and required write grant.

interaction.partitionDenies.criterion: A hop lacking current authority cannot dispatch.

interaction.forgedLabelInert.criterion: A claimed content label cannot change the outcome of the scoped grant decision.

interaction.reserveConserved.criterion: An admitted child share plus the remainder equals the parent's budget.

interaction.cycleFuelTerminates.criterion: The retained prefix of a finite routed trace is bounded by allocated fuel.

interaction.graphHopsBound.criterion: For arbitrary routing graphs including cycles, the causal traversal visits at most its fuel allocation.

interaction.retryOwnerPreserved.criterion: A budgeted child preserves the retry owner and cannot increase the remaining budget.

interaction.replaceDependency.criterion: Equivalent admitted private observations produce equal public reads under the same owner/target.

interaction.openRequiresCredit.criterion: Open is admitted only with positive initial credit within the negotiated window.

interaction.streamConserved.criterion: For an arbitrary command trace, outstanding credit plus delivered chunks equals total granted.

interaction.creditRefusal.criterion: A zero-credit running stream with output ready emits zero chunks.

interaction.streamWitness.criterion: A two-piece request with two grants produces two chunks.

interaction.terminalAtMostOnce.criterion: Reachable traces cannot exceed one terminal outcome.

interaction.closedIgnoresAll.criterion: No command to a completed stream changes its state, including new credits or cancels.

interaction.finishExactlyOne.criterion: Finishing an open stream yields one terminal outcome without another chunk.

interaction.sendOrdinal.criterion: Each accepted send advances the one-based sequence exactly once.

interaction.streamProgress.criterion: Under enough delivered credit and scheduled transitions, any finite remaining work reaches one terminal success.

interaction.duplicateSame.criterion: An exact duplicate is retained without a new delivery.

interaction.duplicateConflict.criterion: A duplicate identity with different content is a conflict.

interaction.ordinalGap.criterion: Unknown noncontiguous sequence produces an explicit gap.

interaction.ackMonotone.criterion: Acknowledgment preserves or increases the retained cursor.

interaction.ackWithin.criterion: Acknowledgment never exceeds the source head.

interaction.historyGap.criterion: A cursor preceding retained history is outside the replay window.

interaction.jobTerminalStable.criterion: An arbitrary sequence of resume/cancel controls preserves every terminal record.

interaction.jobCasExclusive.criterion: After an accepted continuation a duplicate at the same expected revision cannot win.

interaction.cancellationPreservesEffect.criterion: Job cancellation preserves its separately recorded effect outcome.

interaction.newCompensation.criterion: A consequential compensation requires owner authority, its own approval and a distinct id.

interaction.pageProgress.criterion: A nonempty remaining range with positive page budget makes bounded positive progress.

interaction.rangeReconstructs.criterion: Ordered prefix, bounded page and remainder reconstruct any original sequence.

interaction.artifactIntegrity.criterion: Accepting reassembly establishes declared length and agreement with the selected digest function.

interaction.observationInert.criterion: Observing an event preserves the authoritative state.

interaction.readEffectsInert.criterion: Reading a committed output preserves the effect state.

interaction.unconfirmedNeverReissued.criterion: An unconfirmed operation yields no output and remains unconfirmed on scoped readback.

interaction.messageCorrelation.criterion: Answers reference their original message, context and task, attribute the authority and preserve part order.

interaction.dialogWitness.criterion: An authorized all-grants path succeeds and a read without the parent grant is refused.

interaction.admitSource.criterion: The actual Python admission decision computes the formal lifecycle/generation/owner condition for every typed input.

interaction.grantSource.criterion: The deployed Python grant intersection computes the independently specified four-way intersection.

interaction.reserveSource.criterion: The deployed share reservation computes the natural budget remainder on admitted inputs.

interaction.ackSource.criterion: The deployed acknowledgment function computes the published bounded monotone cursor decision.

interaction.continueSource.criterion: The deployed continuation guard computes owner/waiting/revision equality.

interaction.pageSource.criterion: The deployed byte-range helper computes the bounded decoded page size.

interaction.streamSource.criterion: The live Python stream step implements the full normative give/send/finish transition for arbitrary validated naturals and owner flag.

interaction.lifecycle.criterion: Inspect the live instance, retire its stream and surface, reject stale credentials and callbacks, then admit a fresh read.

interaction.stream.criterion: Check ordered SSE chunks, pause at zero credit, gated grant, foreign and late controls, finality, timeout, disconnect and preserved committed/unknown effects.

interaction.events.criterion: Exercise scoped durable/ephemeral subscriptions, deduplication, conflicting payload, restart, cursor gap, ACK monotonicity and release.

interaction.jobs.criterion: Exercise resume race, cancellation, scope, backup/restore and separate authorized compensating operation on the local durable ledger.

interaction.artifact.criterion: Read a Unicode artifact over three bounded frames, then test mismatch, expiry, foreign owner, release, exact EOF, hash and length.

interaction.delegation.criterion: Test explicit local bindings, private replacement, parent identity, retry owner, remaining time, cycle, denied effects, outage survival and inert ordered hooks.

interaction.peerOutage.criterion: Observe elapsed local read under authoritative loss of the optional peer with a five-second limit.

interaction.surface.criterion: Exercise scoped placement, data/action validation, web source/origin/generation admission, explicit fallback and close preserving the durable job.

interaction.keyboard.criterion: Drive refresh and close through a PTY at 28 and 14 effective columns; labels for state, unknown quota, checked time, reset and reconnect remain legible.

interaction.agent.criterion: Drive two-way native fact exchange, clarification, partial answer, delegated authority refusal, budget stop, duplicate and cancellation.

interaction.agentComparison.criterion: Compare a direct and two relayed public exchanges to the same deterministic authority, validate every confirmation, measure bytes and elapsed time.

interaction.viewScope.criterion: A versioned action belongs to the manifest, rendered action list and current grants; current values validate.

interaction.callbackBoundary.criterion: A busy serial channel cannot admit its own synchronous callback, while a separately granted channel can.

interaction.directionSeparatesID.criterion: The same opaque request ID on opposite directions identifies distinct outstanding work.

interaction.keyedDelivery.criterion: An existing tenant/source/event ID produces same or conflict according to actual content equality.

interaction.distinctPublication.criterion: Updating one event key preserves lookup for every distinct scope/source/ID.

interaction.unauthorizedFinishInert.criterion: An unowned terminal control cannot change any stream state.

interaction.rollingCreditProgress.criterion: With a finite available output, delivered credits and scheduled work, a one-credit window suffices for arbitrary finite length.

interaction.pagesReassemble.criterion: Arbitrary finite page requests yield a prefix and suffix that reconstruct the original data.

interaction.byteRankDrops.criterion: A positive page strictly decreases the remaining byte distance inside the artifact.

interaction.surfaceSource.criterion: The running Python guard computes the independently specified eligibility predicate for every Boolean combination.

interaction.callbackSource.criterion: The running Python serial/reverse-channel gate computes the independently specified return-path rule.

interaction.grantEpoch.criterion: Revoking one tenant stops active work immediately at the host gate, rejects old epochs after reconnect and leaves another owner readable.

interaction.background.criterion: An actual independently identified read worker advances only in its allocated scope, stops on revocation and exhausts exactly its finite budget.

interaction.privacy.criterion: Time-limited user state and separately redacted diagnostics have tenant-local access, bounded erasure and declared residency.

interaction.callback.criterion: A real authenticated reverse call reuses the original ID only on a separately admitted direction; self-wait and direct forgery are refused.

interaction.lateOutcome.criterion: Delay delivery after a real SQLite continuation and cancellation commit; report the durable scoped operation ID and recover both actual terminal states and the existing receipt.

interaction.trustedReview.criterion: Rebuild the reviewed digest from the exact tenant, recipient, resource, amount, currency, package and execution intent; only the trusted owner can authorize it.

interaction.socketAndBudget.criterion: Bound continuous header/body drips and propagate the locally shorter parent deadline before a real delayed child request.

interaction.recoveryActions.criterion: A keyboard client creates new work, resumes the saved job, retries a read and reviews a separate exact consent at both widths.

interaction.registry.criterion: Record actual cross-edition frame shapes, outcomes and checked registry operation identity on the executed native agent exchange.

interaction.tenantNoninterference.criterion: Arbitrary updates by a different owner preserve the selected tenant grant, cancellation handle or event record.

interaction.historicalAgent.criterion: The actual frozen 6f6e228 host implementation negotiates with the selected working native agent executor, acquires and confirms a scoped private fact and observes denial outside its grant.

interaction.parallelConservation.criterion: For every finite list of accepted reservations, the parent equals the sum of allocated shares and the remaining amount in each checked dimension.

interaction.oversizedShareRefused.criterion: A share exceeding the remaining resource dimension prevents accepting the allocation.
